summary: Everbright Digital Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the immediate resignation of CFO and director Tang Chak Ming on July 31, 2026, citing personal reasons with no disagreement with the company. The company has begun a search for a successor CFO and will furnish a further 6-K upon appointment. This is a foreign private issuer filing, equivalent to a US current report on Form 8-K for a management change. As a sudden CFO and board departure, this is the event itself. Watch for the successor appointment and any interim CFO designation.
